answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 28366 Country: AU Title: I have seen people, specially Aalim in Mauritius placing Qur'an on the footsteps of the Mimbar(where the Imam puts his feet & where He sit) Is it allowed mufti sb? Question: Assalamualaikum, I have seen people, specially Aalim in Mauritius placing Qur'an on the footsteps of the Mimbar(where the Imam puts his feet & where He sit) Is it allowed mufti sb? Jazakallah Answer ID: 28366 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 158/158/M=1432) It is required etiquette to recite the holy Quran placing it on juzdan, cover, pillows etc. Do not put it at a place, which are trampled by feet but with cover or pillow. (Fatawa Mahmoodiah, Vol. 7, p. 16, published by: Maktaba Mahmoodiayah Meerut) It is mentioned in Hindiyah: لا يلقى في موضع يخل بالتعظيم . (هنديه 5/324) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
